parent: Corrected base-labels-v2 s64l0 FP64 seed 1, epoch 149. Centered FP32 seed 1 is rehearsal only; never train its children.
restart: Always restart epoch-110 pre_stage_two.pt, preserving seed, architecture, offsets, neighbors and two-phase schedule. Original 300 training frames plus every selected harvest set through this round. Never include validation or test frames.
test_rule: Each gated student runs its own fixed-student-test MD from the common seed/replicas, never a previous student's coordinates. Compare with the identical corrected 60-frame MH-1 teacher-test rescored by this same model. Common random starts allowed only between different models' fixed-student-test sets, never across roles.
selection_rule: Out of each parent's 100 new teacher-labelled, student-visited harvest frames, select the 30 largest absolute per-frame force-component RMSE, breaking ties by ascending frame_id. Both target and hot candidates eligible; never consult a test score to rank harvest frames.
decision_rule: Always run two FP64 restarts. After each score pooled force-component RMSE on own target frames divided by that on fixed teacher target frames; report energy, per-species, tail and stress separately. After round 2 only, if own > 1.5 times teacher repeat once with 900 K hot harvest; after round 3 stop regardless. This relative falsifier is not absolute label or full MD acceptance.
